connector.name: bolthub
connector.registryDescription: The bolthub API marketplace, L402 gateways, and your other MCP servers, on one Lightning budget.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace ai.bolthub, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: LND_REST_HOST
env.description: LND REST API URL (recommended wallet; pair with LND_MACAROON). A wallet is optional — without one, free tools and marketplace search still work; paid calls return their payment challenge.

env.name: LND_MACAROON
env.description: Hex-encoded macaroon for LND (use a pay-scoped macaroon in production). Required with LND_REST_HOST.

env.name: NWC_URI
env.description: Nostr Wallet Connect string — easiest setup, works with CoinOS, Alby Hub, Zeus, and more. Alternative to LND.

env.name: LNBITS_URL
env.description: LNbits instance URL (pair with LNBITS_ADMIN_KEY). Alternative wallet.

env.name: LNBITS_ADMIN_KEY
env.description: Admin API key for LNbits. Required with LNBITS_URL.

env.name: PHOENIXD_URL
env.description: Phoenixd HTTP API URL (pair with PHOENIXD_PASSWORD). Alternative wallet.

env.name: PHOENIXD_PASSWORD
env.description: HTTP password for Phoenixd. Required with PHOENIXD_URL.

env.name: BUDGET_SATS
env.description: Maximum sats the server may spend per session (process lifetime), across ALL sources. Unset = unlimited; 0 = free tools only. The config file's budget.sat takes precedence.

env.name: BOLTHUB_ACCOUNT_TOKEN
env.description: Account token for tools that act on YOUR bolthub account (workspace, listing, audit, earnings, and node tools). Optional even for those: the connect_account tool pairs via the browser instead. Never needed to discover, call, or pay for APIs — buying is account-less.

recipes.cli: claude mcp add mcp --env LND_REST_HOST=<lnd-rest-host> --env LND_MACAROON=<your-lnd-macaroon> --env NWC_URI=<your-nwc-uri> --env LNBITS_URL=<lnbits-url> --env LNBITS_ADMIN_KEY=<your-lnbits-admin-key> --env PHOENIXD_URL=<phoenixd-url> --env PHOENIXD_PASSWORD=<your-phoenixd-password> --env BUDGET_SATS=<budget-sats> --env BOLTHUB_ACCOUNT_TOKEN=<your-bolthub-account-token> -- npx -y @bolthub/mcp@0.7.2

recipes.code:
[mcp_servers.mcp]
command = "npx"
args = ["-y", "@bolthub/mcp@0.7.2"]

[mcp_servers.mcp.env]
LND_REST_HOST = "<lnd-rest-host>"
LND_MACAROON = "<your-lnd-macaroon>"
NWC_URI = "<your-nwc-uri>"
LNBITS_URL = "<lnbits-url>"
LNBITS_ADMIN_KEY = "<your-lnbits-admin-key>"
PHOENIXD_URL = "<phoenixd-url>"
PHOENIXD_PASSWORD = "<your-phoenixd-password>"
BUDGET_SATS = "<budget-sats>"
BOLTHUB_ACCOUNT_TOKEN = "<your-bolthub-account-token>"
